pages.quiz:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the syllable بُ read? (1 mark)
   A. baa
   B. ba
   C. bu
   D. bi

2. How do you read the syllable مَ? (1 mark)
   A. ma
   B. lu
   C. bi
   D. si

3. Which sound does the Arabic letter ذ make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. b as in bag
   C. dh as in this
   D. sh as in shop

4. How is the Arabic word جَدَّةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jadda
   B. jadd
   C. ukht
   D. akh

5. How do you read the syllable مُو? (1 mark)
   A. ja
   B. bu
   C. muu
   D. ta

6. What does the Arabic word سَرِيرٌ (sariir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bed
   B. house
   C. book
   D. door

7. What is a good way to give peer feedback on reading? (1 mark)
   A. Only point out errors
   B. Laugh at mistakes
   C. Say nothing
   D. Say what went well and give one tip to improve

8. What is a good aim in a reading contest? (1 mark)
   A. To read as fast as possible
   B. To read correctly and smoothly
   C. To read as loudly as possible
   D. To read without looking

9. Which day name comes from the Arabic word for 'one'? (1 mark)
   A. al-jumuʿa
   B. as-sabt
   C. al-ahad
   D. al-khamiis

10. Which Arabic word means "food"? (1 mark)
   A. شَمْعَةٌ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. طَعَامٌ
   D. بَالُونٌ

11. Which Arabic sentence means "A gift for Amina." (1 mark)
   A. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كَعْكَةٌ
   B. فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ
   C. هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ
   D. هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ

12. What does as-samaku ladhiidh mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fish is delicious.
   B. I like fish.
   C. The fish is cold.
   D. Where is the fish?

13. What does the word mufiid mean? (1 mark)
   A. useful
   B. cold
   C. big
   D. delicious

14. Which Arabic word means "oranges"? (1 mark)
   A. بَطَاطِسُ
   B. طَمَاطِمُ
   C. سَمَكٌ
   D. بُرْتُقَالٌ

15. Which Arabic word means "heart"? (1 mark)
   A. قَلْبٌ
   B. أُذُنٌ
   C. وَجْهٌ
   D. ظَهْرٌ

16. What is a reader's theatre? (1 mark)
   A. A spelling test
   B. A silent reading time
   C. A drawing competition
   D. A group reads a script aloud with expression

17. How is the Arabic word جَبَلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. jabal
   C. nahr
   D. riih

18. How is the Arabic word غَائِمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. mushmis
   B. ghaa'im
   C. shams
   D. haarr

19. Why should a knife be kept out of the reach of small children? (1 mark)
   A. It is old
   B. It can cause harm
   C. It is expensive
   D. It is heavy

20. Which Arabic word means "key"? (1 mark)
   A. خِزَانَةٌ
   B. مِفْتَاحٌ
   C. كُوبٌ
   D. حَمَّامٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana (2 marks)

22. Write in Arabic sounds a question and an answer about bananas and give the meaning. (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Describe three ways to work out the meaning of an unfamiliar word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Describe how a class can make a letter bank. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a (2 marks)

26. Look at a picture of a birthday party with a cake with a candle and friends standing round the table. Make a prediction and give a reason. (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Give the steps for reading a new Arabic word. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Describe the steps of making a class picture book on family celebrations. (4 marks) (4 marks)

30. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i wal-ghaymu fii s-samaa'i. (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Describe how you can make flashcards for the days of the week. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #20 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — bu
   The mark Damma gives the vowel u, so بُ is bu.

2. A — ma
   مَ is read ma.

3. C — dh as in this
   The letter ذ makes the sound dh as in this.

4. A — jadda
   جَدَّةٌ is read jadda and means grandmother.

5. C — muu
   مُو is read muu.

6. A — bed
   سَرِيرٌ (sariir) means bed.

7. D — Say what went well and give one tip to improve
   Feedback should be honest and kind.

8. B — To read correctly and smoothly
   Accuracy and smoothness matter more than speed.

9. C — al-ahad
   al-ahad, Sunday, is the first day.

10. C — طَعَامٌ
   طَعَامٌ (taʿaam) means food.

11. C — هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

12. A — The fish is delicious.
   samak is fish and ladhiidh means delicious.

13. A — useful
   mufiid means useful or good for you.

14. D — بُرْتُقَالٌ
   بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

15. A — قَلْبٌ
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

16. D — A group reads a script aloud with expression
   In a reader's theatre learners read a script aloud, using their voices to act.

17. B — jabal
   جَبَلٌ is read jabal and means mountain.

18. B — ghaa'im
   غَائِمٌ is read ghaa'im and means cloudy.

19. B — It can cause harm
   Sharp items can hurt small children.

20. B — مِفْتَاحٌ
   مِفْتَاحٌ (miftaah) means key.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The key is in the cupboard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: hal tuhibbu l-mawz? naʿam, uhibbu l-mawz. Do you like bananas? Yes, I like bananas.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for each meaning.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use the sentence around the word; use a picture or a word you know; look it up in a dictionary or ask.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give each group some letters; write each letter and its name on a card with a picture or word that begins with it; arrange the cards in order in the class portfolio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for writing cards, 1 mark for adding names or words and 1 mark for arranging them.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: How beautiful the environment is!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends will sing and eat the cake, because the cake has a candle and they stand round the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible prediction and 1 mark for a reason from the picture.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at each letter and its mark; read each syllable; blend the syllables and check that the word makes sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Collect or draw pictures of celebration things; put one on each page; write an Arabic word or sentence with the meaning; make a cover with a title.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky and the clouds are in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each half.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cut cards; write the Arabic day on the front; write the English name and sound on the back; decorate and display in order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.
